technical_complexity.rationale: Rigorous thermodynamics, mass and energy balances and equipment models that engineers trust are research and domain heavy, and AI generated models must be validated.

defensibility.rationale: Deep domain founders and a validated engine are hard to copy, but incumbents have decades of unit models and customer trust.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were adding LLM agents to their simulators in 2026; no action against Dualizer reported.

market_need_then: Chemical plants depend on simulation and several AI process startups launched in 2025 and 2026; founders cite their own experience with AspenTech and AVEVA tools.
